message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll need to make a traditional baked lasagna:

| Category | Typical Items |
|----------|---------------|
| **Pasta** | 9–12 sheets of lasagna noodles (regular or no‑boil) |
| **Meat Sauce** | 1 lb ground beef or a mix of beef & pork; 1 small onion (chopped); 2–3 cloves garlic (minced); 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or passata; 1 can (15 oz) tomato sauce; 1 tbsp tomato paste; 1 tsp dried oregano; 1 tsp dried basil; pinch of red pepper flakes (optional); salt & pepper to taste |
| **Cheese Mixture** | 15 oz ricotta cheese; 1 egg (beaten, optional for binding); ½ cup grated Parmesan; 2 cups shredded mozzarella (or a blend of mozzarella & provolone) |
| **Vegetables (optional)** | Sautéed spinach, sliced mushrooms, diced zucchini, or roasted bell peppers |
| **Herbs & Seasonings** | Fresh basil or parsley for garnish; extra oregano or Italian seasoning for the sauce |
| **Miscellaneous** | Olive oil (for sautéing), butter (for greasing the baking dish), and a splash of milk or cream (if you like a richer béchamel layer) |

Feel free to adjust quantities based on how many servings you’re aiming for or your personal taste preferences!
